description: This module decrypts input using systemd‘s systemd-creds decrypt.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The credential name to validate the embedded credential name.

parameters.name: newline
parameters.description: Whether to add a trailing newline character to the end of the output, if not present. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: The timestamp to use to validate the not-after timestamp that was used during encryption. Takes a timestamp specification in the format described in systemd.time(7).

parameters.name: transcode
parameters.description: Whether to transcode the output before returning it. Choices: "base64" "unbase64" "hex" "unhex"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: A user name or numeric UID when decrypting from a specific user context. If set to the special string self it sets the user to the user of the calling process. Requires systemd 256 or later.

examples:
- name: Decrypt secret
  community.general.systemd_creds_decrypt:
    name: db
    secret: "WhQZht+JQJax1aZemmGLxmAAAA..."
  register: decrypted_secret

- name: Print the decrypted secret
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ decrypted_secret }}"

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The decrypted secret. Note that Ansible only supports returning UTF-8 encoded strings. If the decrypted secret is binary data, or a string encoded in another way, use transcode=base64 or transcode=hex to circument this restriction. You then need to decode the data when using it, for example using the ansible.builtin.b64decode filter. Returned: always Sample: "access_token"
